render_frame = 0

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data

        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()

        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr
import pychrono.driver as driver

# Initialize the PyChrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -9.81, 0))

# Set simulation step size for 50 FPS (0.02 seconds)
step_size = 0.02

# Create the HMMWV vehicle
vehicle = veh.HMMWV_Full(system)
vehicle.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 1.5, 0), chrono.QUNIT))
vehicle.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMeasy)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(step_size)
vehicle.Initialize()

# Create custom terrain using mesh files
# Load collision and visual meshes
mesh_col = chrono.ChTriangleMeshConnected()
mesh_col.LoadWavefrontMesh("Highway_col.obj", True, True)

mesh_vis = chrono.ChTriangleMeshConnected()
mesh_vis.LoadWavefrontMesh("Highway_vis.obj", True, True)

# Create terrain body
terrain_body = chrono.ChBody()
terrain_body.SetBodyFixed(True)
terrain_body.SetCollide(True)
system.Add(terrain_body)

# Add collision mesh to terrain
terrain_body.GetCollisionModel().ClearModel()
terrain_body.GetCollisionModel().AddTriangleMesh(
    mesh_col, 
    chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), 
    chrono.ChMatrix33d(chrono.QUNIT), 
    True, 
    True
)
terrain_body.GetCollisionModel().BuildModel()

# Add visual mesh to terrain
vis_shape = chrono.ChVisualShapeTriangleMesh()
vis_shape.SetMesh(mesh_vis)
vis_shape.SetName("Highway Visualization")
terrain_body.AddVisualShape(vis_shape)

# Initialize Irrlicht application
application = irr.ChIrrApp(system, "HMMWV Simulation", irr.dimension2du(1024, 768))
application.AddTypicalLogo()
application.AddTypicalSky()
application.AddTypicalLights(irr.vector3df(30, 100, 30), irr.vector3df(30, 0, 30), 128)
application.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 5, -10), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))

# Initialize interactive driver
my_driver = driver.InteractiveDriverIRR(application)
my_driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.05)
my_driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.05)
my_driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.05)
my_driver.Initialize()

# Configure step management for real-time simulation
application.SetStepManage(True)
application.SetTimestep(step_size)
application.SetTryRealtime(True)

# Simulation loop
while application.GetDevice().run():
    time = system.GetChTime()

    # Update driver inputs
    my_driver.Advance(step_size)
    driver_inputs = my_driver.GetInputs()

    # Synchronize vehicle with driver inputs
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)

    # Advance the simulation
    system.DoStepDynamics(step_size)

    # Render scene
    application.BeginScene()
    application.DrawAll()
    application.EndScene()

vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)
vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)

terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())

# First terrain patch (Highway)
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
    chrono.GetChronoDataFile('vehicle/terrain/meshes/Highway_col.obj'),
    True, 0.01, False)

vis_mesh = chrono.ChTriangleMeshConnected().CreateFromWavefrontFile(
    veh.GetDataFile("terrain/meshes/Highway_vis.obj"), True, True)

tri_mesh_shape = chrono.ChVisualShapeTriangleMesh()
tri_mesh_shape.SetMesh(vis_mesh)
tri_mesh_shape.SetMutable(False)
patch.GetGroundBody().AddVisualShape(tri_mesh_shape)

# New terrain patch (Bump)
new_patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -42, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
    chrono.GetChronoDataFile('vehicle/terrain/meshes/bump.obj'),
    True, 0.01, False)

vis_mesh_bump = chrono.ChTriangleMeshConnected().CreateFromWavefrontFile(
    veh.GetDataFile("terrain/meshes/bump.obj"), True, True)

tri_mesh_shape_bump = chrono.ChVisualShapeTriangleMesh()
tri_mesh_shape_bump.SetMesh(vis_mesh_bump)
tri_mesh_shape_bump.SetRGBAColor(chrono.ChColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.8))  # RGB color
tri_mesh_shape_bump.SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/dirt.jpg"), 6.0, 6.0)
tri_mesh_shape_bump.SetMutable(False)
new_patch.GetGroundBody().AddVisualShape(tri_mesh_shape_bump)

# Finalize terrain
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('HMMWV Demo')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# Output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between render frames
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Simulation loop
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene
    if step_number % render_steps == 0:
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
